headline: Viji Finance issues notice for postal ballot meeting of shareholders
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: Viji Finance Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. Shareholders will be voting on specific resolutions through this remote voting process. The company has completed the procedural requirement as per regulatory norms. This is a routine corporate filing that does not impact retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate filing with no material impact on retail investors

headline: Viji Finance reports September quarter financial results
summary: Viji Finance Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the exchange. The filing provides regulated financial disclosures for the company's recent operational quarter. Retail investors tracking micro-cap financials can review the reported numbers for revenue and profit metrics to assess earnings growth. Routine earnings disclosures help stakeholders evaluate the fundamental performance of listed entities.
why_it_matters: Quarterly metrics reveal the company's earnings trajectory.
